dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate grey with medium pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-to-medium frequency diffuse mottling distributed across the dorsal plane, more concentrated along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between varying grey tones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white linear mark near the anterior dorsal midline; multiple subtle longitudinal rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Subtle longitudinal rake marks or linear scars visible along the central and lateral dorsal surface.
